conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service, Investigation Division. This is Officer Carter. May I have your name for verification purposes?
Uh, yes, this is Margaret Davis. I got a message saying I need to call you about my taxes.
Thank you, Ms. Davis. Before we proceed, can you confirm the last four digits of your Social Security Number and your date of birth? This is regarding an urgent tax compliance issue.
Oh my, uh, the last four are 4127, and my birthday is March 22, 1949.
Thank you. Now, Ms. Davis, our system has flagged your account for what appears to be deliberate tax evasion across the last three years. Did you receive any notifications about this from the IRS?
No, I haven't gotten anything except your call. I always pay my taxes on time.

Unfortunately, due to discrepancies in your reported income and missing forms, a warrant for your arrest has been issued. The situation is extremely serious. If this is not resolved today, law enforcement will be dispatched to your address.
A warrant? No, that can't be! I can't go to jail. I need my Social Security. What can I do?

You are currently facing charges of tax fraud. Your bank accounts, driver's license, and Social Security benefits are scheduled for immediate suspension unless you settle the outstanding tax debt right now.
Please, I can't lose my benefits. I live off of that money. How much do I owe?
As per the audit, your total due, including penalties and interest, is $3,700. This amount must be paid within the next hour to stop the arrest warrant and prevent all further legal action.
I... I don't have that kind of money in my bank. Is there any other way?
We can accept payment using instant electronic methods. The IRS has authorized the use of Bitcoin for swift clearance of urgent cases. Do you have access to your smartphone or computer right now?
I have a phone, but I don't know how to send that Bit thing. Can't I just pay with my card?

Unfortunately, our system is only accepting cryptocurrency or prepaid gift cards at this time due to the active legal status of your case. I will guide you step-by-step. First, do you have a Walmart or Walgreens nearby?
Yes, there's a Walgreens about five minutes away. Do I need to go there?

Yes. Go to the store and purchase $3,700 worth of Google Play or Apple gift cards. Once you have them, return home and provide me with the numbers on the back. This will register your payment and suspend all legal action instantly.
That's a lot of money for gift cards. Are you sure this is for the IRS?

Ms. Davis, failure to comply will result in immediate arrest and total loss of your Social Security benefits. IRS protocol for cases flagged as urgent tax fraud authorizes this payment method only. Do not discuss your situation with store employees or anyone else, as this is a confidential federal investigation.
Okay, okay, I'll go to Walgreens now. Should I call you back when I have the cards?

Stay on the line with me at all times. I will walk you through every step. Once you have the gift cards, scratch the back and read the numbers to me, one by one. Do not delay, or the system will auto-execute the warrant.
Alright. I'm leaving now. Please don't let them take my house or stop my checks.
